timing: retrospective specification of previously generated candidate

sourceFacts.fact: A large CGG repeat expansion can silence FMR1.
Reduced production of FMRP disrupts its normal role in neuronal function.

invariants: CGG letters correct; FMR1 is gene, FMRP is protein.
Full-mutation mechanism simplified, no DNA break or exact repeat threshold.
expectedLabels: Fragile X: repeat expansion and gene silencing
layoutSpecification: A clean three-panel molecular concept diagram, no realistic DNA structure needed. Title 'Fragile X: repeat expansion and gene silencing'. Panel1 heading 'CGG expansion': a short DNA strip with repeated boxes each exactly 'CGG', followed by an ellipsis to imply many additional repeats. Panel2 heading 'FMR1 silencing': a simple gene ribbon labelled 'FMR1' with a small closed padlock icon, no DNA break. Panel3 heading 'Less FMRP': a few faded teal protein-bead icons, label 'Reduced protein'. Two clear left-to-right arrows connect panels. Tiny bottom text 'Full-mutation mechanism, simplified'. No numeric repeat cutoff, no chromosome snapping, no X-inactivation mosaic explanation, no faces or stereotypes.
forbiddenAnatomy: No claimed anatomical reconstruction, diagnostic image, histology or literal neuroanatomical pathway
No organ cutaways or invented internal spatial relationships
